questions: Should the function handle non-numeric columns in the dataframe, and if so, how (e.g., drop them, encode them)?
What should happen if the target column contains more than two unique classes (multi-class classification)?
Is the bar plot expected to be displayed (plt.show()) or just returned as an Axes object?
Should the function raise an error if the dataframe has only one column (the target column) or no features?
What is the expected behavior if some feature importance scores are zero or negative (though typically non-negative)?
Should the function set a specific figure size for the plot, or use default sizing?
What should be done if the target column has missing values (NaNs)?
Is the function required to work with dataframes where the target column is not of a numeric type (e.g., string labels)?
